text: Westport Albion builds steadily from near the centre circle on their own half, with Kian Castillo intercepting the ball. The team moves forward through a series of short, precise passes focused around Castillo, advancing into the attacking third on the right side. Castillo then plays a sharp, short pass a few metres inside the penalty area on the right flank to Rafael Delacroix, who pushes forward just over four metres from goal. Delacroix shoots with his foot and scores at the Kingsmoor FC goal on the left end, closing the deficit to 2–1 at 22 minutes[#391] [#398] [#401].
